original_english: All the interacting organisms in an area together with the non-living constituents of the environment form an ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Kisi area ke saare interacting organisms aur environment ke non-living hisse milkar ek ecosystem banate hain.

original_english: An ecosystem consists of biotic components comprising living organisms and abiotic components comprising physical factors.
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem mein biotic components hote hain jo living organisms se bane hote hain aur abiotic components hote hain jo physical factors se.

original_english: Abiotic components include physical factors like temperature, rainfall, wind, soil and minerals.
hinglish_roman: Abiotic components mein temperature, rainfall, wind, mitti aur minerals jaise physical factors aate hain.

original_english: Natural ecosystems are forests, ponds and lakes while gardens and crop-fields are human-made ecosystems.
hinglish_roman: Forests, taalaab aur jheel natural ecosystems hain jabki gardens aur khet human-made ecosystems hain.

original_english: All green plants and certain bacteria which can produce food by photosynthesis are called producers.
hinglish_roman: Saare harey paudhe aur kuch bacteria jo photosynthesis se khana bana sakte hain unhe producers kehte hain.

original_english: Producers make organic compounds like sugar and starch from inorganic substances using the radiant energy of the Sun.
hinglish_roman: Producers Surya ki radiant energy use karke inorganic substances se sugar aur starch jaise organic compounds banate hain.

original_english: Organisms which consume the food produced either directly from producers or indirectly by feeding on other consumers are called consumers.
hinglish_roman: Jo organisms producers se seedha ya doosre consumers ko khakar khana prapt karte hain unhe consumers kehte hain.

original_english: Consumers can be classified as herbivores, carnivores, omnivores and parasites.
hinglish_roman: Consumers ko herbivores, carnivores, omnivores aur parasites mein classify kiya ja sakta hai.

original_english: Microorganisms comprising bacteria and fungi break down the dead remains and waste products of organisms.
hinglish_roman: Bacteria aur fungi jaise microorganisms organisms ke dead remains aur waste products ko tod dete hain.

original_english: Decomposers break down complex organic substances into simple inorganic substances that go into the soil.
hinglish_roman: Decomposers complex organic substances ko simple inorganic substances mein tod dete hain jo mitti mein chali jaati hain.

original_english: A series of organisms taking part at various biotic levels form a food chain.
hinglish_roman: Alag-alag biotic levels par hissedari karne wale organisms ki ek series food chain banati hai.

original_english: Each step or level of the food chain forms a trophic level.
hinglish_roman: Food chain ka har step ya level ek trophic level banata hai.

original_english: The autotrophs or producers are at the first trophic level and fix up solar energy for heterotrophs.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs ya producers pehle trophic level par hote hain aur heterotrophs ke liye solar energy fix karte hain.

original_english: Herbivores or primary consumers come at the second trophic level.
hinglish_roman: Herbivores ya primary consumers doosre trophic level par aate hain.

original_english: Small carnivores or secondary consumers are at the third trophic level and larger carnivores form the fourth.
hinglish_roman: Chhote carnivores ya secondary consumers teesre trophic level par hote hain aur bade carnivores chauthe trophic level par.

original_english: Green plants in a terrestrial ecosystem capture about 1% of the energy of sunlight that falls on their leaves.
hinglish_roman: Zameen par rehne wale ecosystem mein harey paudhe unpar padne wali sunlight ka lagbhag 1% energy capture karte hain.

original_english: An average of 10% of the food eaten is turned into the organism's own body and made available for the next level of consumers.
hinglish_roman: Khaye gaye khane ka average 10% organism ke khud ke body mein convert hota hai aur agli level ke consumers ke liye available hota hai.

original_english: Since so little energy is available for the next level, food chains generally consist of only three or four steps.
hinglish_roman: Kyunki agli level ke liye bahut kam energy bachti hai, food chains mein aamtaur par sirf teen ya chaar steps hote hain.

original_english: There are generally a greater number of individuals at the lower trophic levels of an ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem ke lower trophic levels par aamtaur par zyada individuals hote hain.

original_english: Each organism is generally eaten by two or more other kinds of organisms forming a food web instead of a straight food chain.
hinglish_roman: Har organism ko aamtaur par do ya zyada tarah ke organisms kha lete hain jisse seedhi food chain ki jagah food web banta hai.

original_english: The flow of energy in an ecosystem is unidirectional.
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem mein energy ka flow unidirectional hota hai.

original_english: Energy captured by autotrophs does not revert back to the solar input and energy passed to herbivores does not come back to autotrophs.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs dwara capture ki gayi energy wapas solar input mein nahi jaati aur herbivores ko di gayi energy autotrophs ke paas nahi aati.

original_english: The energy available at each trophic level gets diminished progressively due to loss of energy at each level.
hinglish_roman: Har trophic level par energy ki loss ke karan available energy progressively kam hoti jaati hai.

original_english: Pesticides and other chemicals used to protect crops are washed down into the soil or water bodies.
hinglish_roman: Fasal bachane ke liye use kiye gaye pesticides aur chemicals mitti ya paani mein bah jaate hain.

original_english: These chemicals are absorbed by plants along with water and minerals from the soil.
hinglish_roman: Yeh chemicals mitti se paani aur minerals ke saath plants dwara absorb kar liye jaate hain.

original_english: Since these chemicals are not degradable they get accumulated progressively at each trophic level.
hinglish_roman: Kyunki yeh chemicals degrade nahi hote, yeh har trophic level par progressively accumulate hote jaate hain.

original_english: The phenomenon by which harmful chemicals get accumulated progressively at each trophic level is known as biological magnification.
hinglish_roman: Jis phenomenon mein haanikaarak chemicals har trophic level par progressively accumulate hote hain use biological magnification kehte hain.

original_english: As human beings occupy the top level in any food chain, the maximum concentration of these chemicals gets accumulated in our bodies.
hinglish_roman: Kyunki manushya kisi bhi food chain mein sabse upar hote hain, in chemicals ki sabse zyada concentration hamare body mein jama ho jaati hai.

original_english: Our food grains such as wheat and rice, vegetables, fruits and even meat contain varying amounts of pesticide residues.
hinglish_roman: Hamare gehu aur chaawal jaise anaaj, sabziyan, phal aur yahan tak ki meat mein bhi alag-alag maatra mein pesticide residues hote hain.

original_english: Ozone is a molecule formed by three atoms of oxygen and is a deadly poison at ground level.
hinglish_roman: Ozone ek molecule hai jo teeen oxygen atoms se bana hota hai aur ground level par yeh ek khatarnaak zeher hai.

original_english: At the higher levels of the atmosphere, ozone performs an essential function of shielding Earth from UV radiation.
hinglish_roman: Atmosphere ke upar ke hisson mein ozone ek zaroori kaam karta hai, woh dharti ko UV radiation se bachata hai.

original_english: UV radiation is highly damaging to organisms and is known to cause skin cancer in human beings.
hinglish_roman: UV radiation organisms ke liye bahut haanikaarak hai aur yeh insaano mein skin cancer kar sakti hai.

original_english: Ozone at higher levels of the atmosphere is a product of UV radiation acting on oxygen molecules.
hinglish_roman: Atmosphere ke upar ozone tab banta hai jab UV radiation oxygen molecules par kaam karta hai.

original_english: Higher energy UV radiations split apart oxygen molecules into free oxygen atoms which then combine with molecular oxygen to form ozone.
hinglish_roman: Zyada energy wali UV radiations oxygen molecules ko tod kar free oxygen atoms banati hain jo phir molecular oxygen se milkar ozone banate hain.

original_english: The amount of ozone in the atmosphere began to drop sharply in the 1980s.
hinglish_roman: 1980s mein atmosphere mein ozone ki maatra tezi se girne lagi.

original_english: The decrease in ozone has been linked to synthetic chemicals like chlorofluorocarbons which are used as refrigerants.
hinglish_roman: Ozone ki kami ka sambandh chlorofluorocarbons jaise synthetic chemicals se joda gaya hai jo refrigerants ke roop mein use hote hain.

original_english: CFCs are used as refrigerants and in fire extinguishers.
hinglish_roman: CFCs refrigerants ke roop mein aur fire extinguishers mein use hote hain.

original_english: In 1987, the United Nations Environment Programme succeeded in forging an agreement to freeze CFC production at 1986 levels.
hinglish_roman: 1987 mein, United Nations Environment Programme ne CFC production ko 1986 ke levels par freeze karne ka agreement kiya.

original_english: It is now mandatory for all manufacturing companies to make CFC-free refrigerators throughout the world.
hinglish_roman: Ab duniyabhar ki saari manufacturing companies ke liye CFC-free refrigerators banana zaroori hai.

original_english: Substances that are broken down by biological processes are said to be biodegradable.
hinglish_roman: Jo substances biological processes se toot jaate hain unhe biodegradable kaha jaata hai.

original_english: Substances that are not broken down by biological processes are said to be non-biodegradable.
hinglish_roman: Jo substances biological processes se nahi toote unhe non-biodegradable kaha jaata hai.

original_english: Many human-made materials like plastics will not be broken down by the action of bacteria or other saprophytes.
hinglish_roman: Plastic jaise bahut se human-made materials bacteria ya saprophytes se nahi tootenge.

original_english: Non-biodegradable substances may be inert and persist in the environment for a long time or may harm the various members of the ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Non-biodegradable substances ya toh inert hote hain aur kaafi time tak environment mein rehte hain ya phir ecosystem ke members ko nuksan pahunchate hain.

original_english: Specific enzymes are needed for the breakdown of particular substances which is why we cannot get energy from coal.
hinglish_roman: Specific substances ke breakdown ke liye specific enzymes chahiye isliye hum koyle se energy nahi le sakte.

original_english: Changes in lifestyle have resulted in greater amounts of waste material generation.
hinglish_roman: Lifestyle mein badlaav ki wajah se zyada maatra mein waste material generate hone laga hai.

original_english: Changes in packaging have resulted in much of our waste becoming non-biodegradable.
hinglish_roman: Packaging mein badlaav ki wajah se hamaara zyaadatar waste non-biodegradable ho gaya hai.

original_english: We are an integral part of the environment and changes in the environment affect us.
hinglish_roman: Hum environment ka ek important hissa hain aur environment mein badlaav humpar bhi asar karta hai.

original_english: Our activities pollute the environment and change the world around us.
hinglish_roman: Hamare kaam environment ko pollute karte hain aur hamare aas-paas ki duniya ko badal dete hain.

original_english: A food web consists of many food chains interconnected with each other.
hinglish_roman: Food web mein ek doosre se judi kai food chains hoti hain.

original_english: The various components of an ecosystem are interdependent on each other.
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem ke saare components ek doosre par dependent hote hain.

original_english: Producers make the energy from sunlight available to the rest of the ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Producers sunlight se energy le kar baaki ecosystem ke liye available karate hain.

original_english: There is a loss of energy as we go from one trophic level to the next which limits the number of trophic levels in a food chain.
hinglish_roman: Jab hum ek trophic level se doosre par jaate hain toh energy ki loss hoti hai jisse food chain mein trophic levels ki sankhya seemit ho jaati hai.

original_english: Human activities have a strong impact on the environment around us.
hinglish_roman: Manushyon ke kaam hamare aas-paas ke environment par bada asar dalte hain.

original_english: The use of chemicals like CFCs has endangered the ozone layer.
hinglish_roman: CFCs jaise chemicals ke use ne ozone layer ko khatare mein daal diya hai.

original_english: The ozone layer protects against ultraviolet radiation from the Sun which could otherwise damage the environment.
hinglish_roman: Ozone layer Surya ki ultraviolet radiation se bachati hai jo environment ko nuksan pohuncha sakti hai.

original_english: The waste we generate may be biodegradable or non-biodegradable and its disposal is causing serious environmental problems.
hinglish_roman: Humara generate kiya hua waste biodegradable ya non-biodegradable ho sakta hai aur iska disposal serious environmental problems kar raha hai.

original_english: An aquarium is an example of a human-made ecosystem that can become self-sustaining.
hinglish_roman: Aquarium human-made ecosystem ka ek example hai jo self-sustaining ban sakta hai.

original_english: When green plants are eaten by primary consumers a great deal of energy is lost as heat to the environment.
hinglish_roman: Jab primary consumers harey paudhe khaate hain toh bahut saari energy heat ke roop mein environment mein chali jaati hai.

original_english: From autotrophs the energy goes to heterotrophs and decomposers.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs se energy heterotrophs aur decomposers tak pahunchti hai.

original_english: Pesticide residues cannot always be removed from food by washing or other means.
hinglish_roman: Khane se pesticide residues hamesha dhone ya doosre tarike se nahi haate ja sakte.

original_english: Inorganic substances released by decomposers go into the soil and are used once more by plants.
hinglish_roman: Decomposers dwara nikale gaye inorganic substances mitti mein chale jaate hain aur phir se plants use karte hain.

original_english: A garden ecosystem has plants like grasses, trees and flower-bearing plants, and animals like frogs, insects and birds.
hinglish_roman: Garden ecosystem mein ghaas, ped aur phool dene wale paudhe hote hain aur mendak, keede aur pakshi jaise jaanwar bhi hote hain.

original_english: Aquatic plants and animals absorb chemicals from water bodies through which they enter the food chain.
hinglish_roman: Paani mein rehne wale paudhe aur jaanwar paani ke zariye chemicals absorb kar lete hain aur aise woh food chain mein aa jaate hain.

original_english: The introduction of disposable cups was hailed as a step forward for reasons of hygiene but had a huge environmental impact.
hinglish_roman: Disposable cups ki shuruaat ko hygiene ke kaaranon se ek achha kadam mana gaya lekin iska bahut bada environmental impact hua.

original_english: Making kulhads on a large scale would result in the loss of fertile top-soil.
hinglish_roman: Bade paimane par kulhad banane se upjaau upar wali mitti ka nuksaan hoga.

original_english: Plastics are acted upon by physical processes like heat and pressure but persist for a long time under normal conditions.
hinglish_roman: Plastics par heat aur pressure jaise physical processes ka asar padta hai lekin normal conditions mein yeh bahut time tak rehte hain.

original_english: Electronic waste contains hazardous materials that can harm the environment if not disposed of properly.
hinglish_roman: Electronic waste mein khatarnaak materials hote hain jo sahi tarike se dispose na kiya jaye toh environment ko nuksan pahuncha sakte hain.

original_english: Recycling of plastics can also have an impact on the environment depending on the process used.
hinglish_roman: Plastics ki recycling bhi environment par asar daal sakti hai, yeh process par depend karta hai.

original_english: The interactions among various components of the environment involve flow of energy from one component to another.
hinglish_roman: Environment ke alag-alag components ke beech interactions mein energy ek component se doosre mein flow hoti hai.

original_english: Autotrophs capture the energy present in sunlight and convert it into chemical energy.
hinglish_roman: Autotrophs sunlight mein maujood energy ko capture karke chemical energy mein convert karte hain.

original_english: All organisms together with physical surroundings interact with each other and maintain a balance in nature.
hinglish_roman: Saare organisms physical surroundings ke saath ek doosre se interact karke prakriti mein santulan banaye rakhte hain.

original_english: Kitchen waste like spoilt food, vegetable peels and used tea leaves are examples of biodegradable waste.
hinglish_roman: Kharab khana, sabzi ke chhilke aur istemaal ki hui chai ki patti jaise kitchen waste biodegradable waste ke examples hain.

original_english: Even if all waste generated is biodegradable, improper disposal can still harm the environment.
hinglish_roman: Chahe sara waste biodegradable ho, galat tarike se dispose karne par bhi yeh environment ko nuksan pahuncha sakta hai.

original_english: Carrying cloth bags while shopping and switching off unnecessary lights are environment-friendly practices.
hinglish_roman: Shopping ke waqt kapde ke bag le jaana aur gerza roshan band karna environment-friendly practices hain.

original_english: Global summits involving developed and developing countries are regularly held to discuss environmental issues.
hinglish_roman: Developed aur developing countries ko involve karte hue global summits niyamit roop se environmental issues discuss karne ke liye hote hain.

original_english: What are trophic levels? Give an example of a food chain and state the different trophic levels in it.
hinglish_roman: Trophic levels kya hote hain? Food chain ka ek example do aur usme alag-alag trophic levels batao.

original_english: What is the role of decomposers in the ecosystem?
hinglish_roman: Ecosystem mein decomposers ka kya role hota hai?

original_english: Why are some substances biodegradable and some non-biodegradable?
hinglish_roman: Kuch substances biodegradable kyun hote hain aur kuch non-biodegradable?

original_english: What is ozone and how does it affect the ecosystem?
hinglish_roman: Ozone kya hai aur yeh ecosystem ko kaise affect karta hai?

original_english: How can you help in reducing the problem of waste disposal?
hinglish_roman: Waste disposal ki problem kam karne mein tum kaise madad kar sakte ho?

original_english: What is biological magnification? Will the levels of this magnification be different at different levels of the ecosystem?
hinglish_roman: Biological magnification kya hai? Kya ecosystem ke alag-alag levels par is magnification ki maatra alag hogi?

original_english: What will happen if we kill all the organisms in one trophic level?
hinglish_roman: Agar hum ek trophic level ke saare organisms ko khatam kar dein toh kya hoga?

original_english: Why is damage to the ozone layer a cause for concern?
hinglish_roman: Ozone layer ko nuksan kyun ek chinta ka vishay hai?

original_english: What are the problems caused by non-biodegradable wastes that we generate?
hinglish_roman: Hamare dwara generate kiye gaye non-biodegradable wastes se kya problems hoti hain?

original_english: Compare food chains found in a forest, grassland and pond ecosystem.
hinglish_roman: Forest, grassland aur pond ecosystem mein paayi jaane wali food chains ko compare karo.

original_english: Give two examples each of biodegradable and non-biodegradable substances.
hinglish_roman: Biodegradable aur non-biodegradable substances ke do-do examples do.

original_english: What is the difference between a food chain and a food web?
hinglish_roman: Food chain aur food web mein kya antar hai?

original_english: What is the source of pesticides in our food items and how do they enter our bodies?
hinglish_roman: Hamare khane mein pesticides kahan se aate hain aur yeh hamare sharir mein kaise pahunchte hain?

original_english: What steps are being taken to limit the damage to the ozone layer?
hinglish_roman: Ozone layer ko hone wale nuksan ko seemit karne ke liye kya kadam uthaye ja rahe hain?

original_english: Can the organisms of any trophic level be removed without causing any damage to the ecosystem?
hinglish_roman: Kya kisi bhi trophic level ke organisms ko ecosystem ko bina nuksan pahunchaye hataya ja sakta hai?

original_english: Decomposers break down dead organisms into simple inorganic substances.
hinglish_roman: Decomposers mare hue organisms ko simple inorganic substances mein tod dete hain.
hinglish_with_error: Decomposers mare hue organisms ko simple inorganic substances mein todti hain.
gec_explanation: 'Decomposers' is treated as masculine or gender-neutral plural in code-mixed Hindi usage. 'Todti hain' is the feminine plural form and is grammatically incorrect. The correct form is 'tod dete hain' using the masculine auxiliary, consistent with the gender-neutral subject 'decomposers'.

original_english: Ozone layer protects the Earth from harmful UV radiation.
hinglish_roman: Ozone layer dharti ko haanikaarak UV radiation se bachata hai.
hinglish_with_error: Ozone layer dharti ko haanikaarak UV radiation se bachati hai.
gec_explanation: In Hindi, 'layer' (or 'ozone layer' as a compound noun) is treated as masculine in common code-mixed usage, similar to how borrowed English nouns default to masculine. 'Bachati hai' is a feminine auxiliary form and is incorrect here. The correct auxiliary is 'bachata hai' (masculine).

original_english: Food chains generally consist of only three or four trophic levels.
hinglish_roman: Food chains mein aamtaur par sirf teen ya chaar trophic levels hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Food chains mein aamtaur par sirf teen ya chaar trophic levels hota hain.
gec_explanation: 'Trophic levels' is plural, so the Hindi auxiliary must also be in plural form. 'Hota hain' mixes singular 'hota' with plural 'hain', which is a number agreement error. The correct form is 'hote hain' where both the participle and the auxiliary are in plural form.

original_english: CFCs are released into the atmosphere and cause depletion of the ozone layer.
hinglish_roman: CFCs atmosphere mein release hote hain aur ozone layer ko khatam karte hain.
hinglish_with_error: CFCs atmosphere mein released hote hain aur ozone layer ko khatam karte hain.
gec_explanation: When an English verb is used before a Hindi auxiliary like 'hote hain', it must remain in its base/uninflected form. 'Released' is the past participle form of the verb and is incorrect in this compound Hindi-English construction. The correct usage is 'release hote hain' with the base verb form.

original_english: Biological magnification causes pesticides to accumulate more at higher trophic levels.
hinglish_roman: Biological magnification ki wajah se pesticides upar ke trophic levels mein zyada accumulate hote hain.
hinglish_with_error: Biological magnification ki wajah se pesticides upar ke trophic levels mein zyada accumulates hote hain.
gec_explanation: In code-mixed Hinglish, when an English verb precedes the Hindi auxiliary 'hote hain', it must appear in its base form without any English inflection. 'Accumulates' adds a third-person singular '-s' suffix which is redundant and incorrect because tense and agreement are already conveyed by 'hote hain'. The correct form is 'accumulate hote hain'.
